synthetic_boundary: Vehicle identities and fleet positions are deterministic demonstration state.
Vehicle operating masses and fallback energy baselines are representative showcase values, not OEM telemetry.
When live route authority is unavailable, the UI uses a clearly labelled deterministic demo corridor rather than disguising fabricated routes as live data.
Road-weather/TMS/charging/fuel demo fallbacks are deterministic and visibly labelled when a remote feed does not provide usable values.
